statistic: Arm median; reduction = 100 * (1 - newer median / older median). No pooled cohorts or confidence claim.

units.B/op: Managed bytes per measured application operation

allocation_chart_scale: Bar widths scale separately within each workload from zero; labels are actual GB, never normalized values.

sdk.source: RC2 VMR F# subtree, locally built; not an official RC2 SDK
sdk.reason: RC2 and main have byte-identical production sources. Their full F# subtrees differ in build scripts, tests and documentation.

sdk_payload.bootstrap: Pinned RC2 sources compiled by SDK 11 RC1, then used to compile the Release product and new Core
sdk_payload.compiler_build_core: Fresh source Core, netstandard2.1, following repository project references
sdk_payload.deployed_core_reason: Match the Core variant selected for SDK tools by #20555
sdk_payload.runtime_qualification: The local RC2-source compiler runs on the exact .NET 11 RC1 runtime. It is a source-built compiler comparison, not a measurement of an official RC2 SDK/runtime bundle.

new.source: Self-hosted Release build of the same pinned VMR RC2/main production source as the third-wave campaign

framework.compiler_gc: Server GC and very-large-object support, matching desktop fsc configuration
framework.allocation_api: AppDomain.MonitoringTotalAllocatedMemorySize: current compiler AppDomain, all threads; ARM enabled
framework.path_support: Native longPathAware manifest; required to read the unchanged 260+ character source paths. No source/path rewriting.

programs.label: Cart-price List.fold
programs.code: List.fold (fun s struct (p, q) -> s + p * q * (100 - d) / 100) 0 items

programs.label: Access-rule exists / forall
programs.code:
let any = List.exists (fun x -> x > lo) xs
List.forall (fun x -> x < hi) xs && any

programs.label: Weighted Array.fold / fold2
programs.code: Array.fold (fun s x -> s + x * k) 0 xs + Array.fold2 (fun s x w -> s + x * w * k) 0 xs ws

programs.label: Nested group folds
programs.code: List.fold (fun s xs -> s + List.fold (fun t x -> t + x * k) 0 xs) 0 groups

programs.label: Filtering and mapping
programs.code: List.sum (List.map (fun x -> x + k) (List.filter (fun x -> x > lo) xs))

programs.label: Escaping closure
programs.code:
saved <- fun x -> x + offset
saved n

function_inlining.criterion: Existing public List/Array functions whose implementation gains inline plus InlineIfLambda, including an already-inline function newly gaining InlineIfLambda. This is a source inventory, not a per-function allocation benchmark.
function_inlining.exclusions: Already-inlined lambda parameters and newly introduced APIs such as partitionWith are excluded. Removing a lambda closure does not remove collection, option, exception, or user-code allocations.

changes.scope: Array.init; already present in RC1, before the article's late-summer PR window
